description.en: Connects a work folder to a Trello board: lists are states, card numbers are ids.
description.es: Conecta una carpeta de trabajos a un tablero de Trello: las listas son estados y el número de tarjeta es el id.

hint.en: Create a Power-Up at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin to get its API key, then open https://trello.com/1/authorize?expiration=never&scope=read,write&response_type=token&key=YOUR_KEY to get a token. Paste them as key:token.
hint.es: Creá un Power-Up en https://trello.com/power-ups/admin para obtener su API key y después abrí https://trello.com/1/authorize?expiration=never&scope=read,write&response_type=token&key=TU_KEY para obtener un token. Pegalos como key:token.
